serverInfo.name: 1lookup
serverInfo.description: Phone, email, and IP validation for AI agents. OAuth 2.1, no API key.

tools.name: validate_phone
tools.description: Validate a phone number: confirms it is real and active, and returns line type, carrier, DNC status, and a fraud/risk score. Spends 1 credit.

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Verify an email address: checks that it exists and is deliverable, and flags disposable, role-based, and risky addresses. Spends 1 credit.

tools.name: ip_lookup
tools.description: Look up an IP address: geolocation, connection type, and proxy/VPN/Tor/datacenter flags with a fraud/risk score. Spends 1 credit.

tools.name: bulk_verify
tools.description: Validate up to 50 phones, emails, or IPs in one call. Returns a per-item result array. Spends 1 credit per item.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get the 1Lookup organization's plan and remaining credits. Free, spends no credits.

notes: Requires a paid 1Lookup plan; free-plan accounts receive HTTP 403 UPGRADE_REQUIRED. Tool calls draw on the same universal credits as the REST API with no separate MCP fee. Transport is streamable HTTP; SSE is disabled.
